ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What would happen if the toothfish was removed?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. In the diagram there is an arrow from Algae pointing to Krill, and there are also arrows from Krill pointing to some animals that eat krill, so the arrows indicate from food/prey to consumer/predator. Patagonian toothfish is located at the lower left of the diagram, and the nearby "Herring, anchovies, and squids" has an arrow pointing to toothfish, indicating that toothfish eat these fish/squids. Reasoning: If toothfish were removed, its predation pressure on prey such as herring would decrease. Therefore the number of herring would increase.
